text: You don't need to go there for now.
The map is under construction.\nPlease wait for the update.
So this is Opia Twinpalms? It's a pretty nice\nplace, isn't it?
Yeah, not bad.\nThe weather is mild, and the wind feels good.\nI could doze off any second.
I've already checked out this place because\nI spent some time here myself. Many of the plants\nthat grow here are rare and valuable.
According to my partner, the minerals found in the\nmountains are all rare too.
Hmm...You don't need to think about it now.\nYou'll know when the time comes.
You're being kinda secretive, you know~
You're so creepy.\nI can't even tell where you're looking with those\neyes.
Well, Kunon...\nCould you go fetch Vasaria with the Ark?
N-no, uh, but why do you want me to go fetch\nVasaria...?!
Yeah, there's something I'd like her to help me\nwith.
B-but, you know that Anono is on board...
Yeah, could you please go with her, Reliza?\nI need you to take care of Anono.
Alright then, I'm counting on you, Kunon...
Geez! Kunon acts like she doesn't wanna do it~!\nI bet she's actually thrilled because she thinks\nshe might be rewarded with gold and silver~!
You think so? She really doesn't look like she\nwants to do it, though...
Kunon! Reliza! We're leaving Anono to you!
Yeah! I won't forgive you if you bully him!
Hey, don't say things that could give people the\nwrong idea about me! Anono is like family to me...
Don't worry, I'll take care of him and stay with\nhim the whole time!
Now that I think about it, this situation is\nstarting to look pretty bad for us.
Kunon is gone, Reliza and Anono aren't here\neither...\nIt's just us and that weird god now, you know?
That means it's our chance to keep all the gold\nand silver...I mean, the reward for ourselves!
It's not gonna be that easy, you know?\nHe's no ordinary god!
Alright, I've got something I'd like to ask you\nto do as well. Can you come with me?
Hmm...I'm starting to get a little worried...
